debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d t-o r-e-l-a-b-e-l i-m-p-o-r-t-e-d m-e-d-i-c-i-n-e u-s-i-n-g s-e-a-l-e-d e-x-h-i-b-i-t s and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d d-r-a-f-t l-a-b-e-l-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
2) the a-c-t-o-r b-e-g-a-n t-o f-a-l-s-i-f-y s-e-r-i-a-l-i-z-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s by m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-i-n-g t-h-e s-w-a-p f-i-l-e-s and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d t-a-m-p-e-r s-h-e-e-t-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k
3) the a-c-t-o-r t-r-i-e-d t-o d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e t-h-r-o-u-g-h p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s via c-o-v-e-r n-o-t-e-s and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d t-h-e p-a-c-k-a-g-e m-a-n-i-f-e-s-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r y a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l
4) the a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d f-a-k-e c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n l-o-g s with t-e-m-p e-r-a-t-u-r-e a-d-j-u-s-t-m-e-n-t s and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d t-h-e m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d d-a-t-a while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-h-i-r-d p-a-r-t-y a-u-d-i-t
5) the a-c-t-o-r f-i-n-a-l-l-y a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d t-h-e c-l-o-s-e-d e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e f-i-l-e-s i-n-t-o t-h-e r-e-c-o-r-d and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d t-h-e i-n-d-e-x e-n-t-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-n-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w
